## Speaker
Shaowu Zhang

### Theme
A Mini-Course on Non-Archimedean Geometry (2/4)

### Abstract
This mini-course is a gentle introduction to non-Archimedean geometry. We will introduce fundamental concepts such as classical rigid analytic spaces, the analytification functor, and Berkovich spaces, before applying this machinery to study p-adic differential equations. Time permitting, we will also explain recent applications of non-Archimedean geometry to enumerative and birational geometry.
